lines.text: Use one lesson at a time: mapped video/source → close it → read the complete lesson in this Mentor → follow the guided example once → do the independent task → save your genuine attempt → review → changed retry → explain.
The written lesson is self-sufficient. A video helps you visualise the skill but does not replace your own attempt.
Save the actual workbook, query, PBIX, notebook, SQL output, screenshot, validation note or business explanation produced by the lesson.
A copied answer is not independent evidence. A wrong genuine attempt is useful because the review can target the exact weakness.
Finish the lessons and local practice. Use Quick revision. Attempt the module test before protected answers. Repair the specific miss and retry on changed work.
Do not open protected review first. Keep the first attempt and correction as separate evidence.
Gate A → save attempt → Review A → repair → different fresh Gate B → save attempt → Review B. Gate C is remediation-only when the course explicitly assigns it.
There is no percentage shortcut. The point of the gate is independent transfer.
Identify the smallest failing step, error, unexpected result or definition you cannot explain. Re-open only the relevant lesson section and reproduce the guided example once.
Then close the explanation and retry with changed input. Do not restart the whole course because of one local mistake.
